exact_query: arXiv e-print tarball 1512.05734 (Rodney et al. 2016, ApJ 820, 50, 'SN Refsdal: Photometry and Time Delay Measurements of the First Einstein Cross Supernova'); LaTeX source TableResultsSummary.tex, label tab:ResultsSummary
extraction: Parsed the 'Summary of Time Delay and Magnification Ratio Measurements' table directly from the arXiv LaTeX source (the numeric values are literal in this paper's source, unlike Kelly 2023 where they are undefined macros). Two independent fitting methods are reported side by side: template light-curve fits and polynomial curve fits. Row count asserted == 12.
note: MACS J1149.5+2223 - MEASURED TIME DELAYS among the four Einstein-cross images S1-S4 of SN Refsdal, published BEFORE the fifth image SX reappeared. 12 rows = 3 image pairs (S2-S1, S3-S1, S4-S1) x 2 methods x 2 quantities (time delay in days, magnification ratio). RAW OBSERVABLES from light-curve fitting, not lens-model outputs. Complements MACSJ1149_SNRefsdal_time_delays_Kelly2023.tsv, which supersedes these and adds the SX-S1 delay of 376 days.
